Use_Case: Family starts a bounded handheld take and designates who is being recorded.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Rolling pre-roll buffer captures ≥N seconds before Start; (2) Session splits into segments on pause/resume; (3) Tap-to-designate subject sets active subject for the take; (4) Stop ends the session and retains local media in IndexedDB. FAIL if start has no pre-roll or subject cannot be designated.

Use_Case: Family processes video locally; bystanders are blurred in preview; raw upload is not the default.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Preview applies bystander/face blur before share; (2) Scoring runs post-capture via local :8010 (pilot OK) without requiring cloud upload of raw video; (3) Trust copy states true on-device ML is not claimed. Full phone-side ML remains Deferred. FAIL if blur is missing on share preview or copy claims full on-device ML.

Use_Case: Family controls who may record and how consent/assent/redaction apply during capture.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Only members with can_record can start capture; (2) Consent keys and assent pause leave durable marks (assent_events); (3) Manual redaction/blur tools available on retained segments. FAIL if non-recorder can capture or assent pause leaves no record.

Use_Case: Family is warned before capture fails due to storage/battery/quota or detect-down.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Low IndexedDB/storage quota shows blocking or caution UI before Record; (2) Low-battery caution shown when available via browser APIs; (3) Detect-down/stub mode is labeled (no silent wrong confidence). FAIL if capture starts with no storage warning when quota is exhausted.

Use_Case: System labels self-regulating behaviors neutrally (never as a problem or grade).
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) behavior_classes / UI labels use neutral wording (e.g. covering ears, hair twirling); (2) No grades, scores-of-person, or leaderboards in family UI; (3) Tracked-behaviours settings copy says logged as observed. FAIL if pathologizing language or ranking appears.

Use_Case: After capture, family runs detect and gets timed events for appearance classes.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) POST :8010/api/detect/video returns events with start/end for ear_cover, hair_twirling, head_nodding; (2) Events persist to sessions/events; (3) S1-T06/S3-T02 fixtures cover empty vs mislabel cases. FAIL if detect returns empty on known-positive fixture without documented threshold reason.

Use_Case: Family designates subject via boxes/tap; no biometric gallery required for unsupervised family detect.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Subject selection is box/tap only; (2) identity.enabled false for family unsupervised path; (3) EdgeFace/Active Subject gallery not required to score; (4) If EdgeFace demo remains reachable, it is labeled demo-only or hidden (S5-T06). FAIL if family detect blocks without a face gallery.

Use_Case: Family or clinician confirms, corrects, or rejects a detected event.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) UI offers confirm / correct / reject; (2) Choice persists (event_verifications or equivalent); (3) Corrected class/time visible on reload. FAIL if reject leaves event unchanged or unlogged.

Use_Case: Verification outcomes feed a queryable labeled feedback store for calibration.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Each confirm/correct/reject writes a row with event_id, decision, optional corrected_class, actor, timestamp; (2) Table/queryable store exists (S3-T01); (3) Detector eval scripts still runnable offline. FAIL if verification UI has no durable store.

Use_Case: Agency group rooms attribute events across many children.
Acceptance_Criteria: Deferred - agency multi-subject attribution only. Family remains single-subject. No pilot AC; note in S6-T04 deferral memo.

Use_Case: Vocal/mand path has an explicit go/no-go; stub is not silently treated as accurate audio ML.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) S3-T03 spike doc states ship audio model vs keep stub with owner+date; (2) UI reliability copy for vocal/mand matches stub vs real; (3) S4-T06 either ships first vocal class or records deferral in backlog. FAIL if UI implies word understanding or silent fake confidence.

Capability: Environmental Robustness - Low Light & Dynamic Lighting
Use_Case: Family gets a pre-record tip when lighting is too poor for reliable capture.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Pre-record luminance check (or equivalent) shows tip when average luminance is low; (2) Tip does not claim ML robustness; (3) Capture still allowed with acknowledgment (S5-T05). FAIL if no guidance exists for dark preview.

Use_Case: Family opens a session and sees timed behavior entries.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Log lists class, start, duration; (2) Entries match persisted events; (3) Empty state is clear when no events. FAIL if times missing or wrong class shown.

Use_Case: Selecting a log entry seeks video to that moment with antecedent lead-in.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Tap seek lands at event start minus configured antecedent lead-in; (2) Player shows context before the behavior; (3) Works for multi-segment sessions. FAIL if seek ignores lead-in or wrong segment.

Use_Case: Family shares an episode (event + lead-in) by default, not the whole session.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Default share grant item = event + antecedent window; (2) Full-session share is explicit opt-in; (3) Clinician grant scopes to selected items (S2-T05). FAIL if default grant is entire session without opt-in.

Use_Case: Family adds notes on sessions or events that persist after reload.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Note CRUD works; (2) Notes appear in export metadata; (3) RLS limits notes to household. FAIL if notes vanish on reload.

Use_Case: Family sees week/month counts by class with no ranking of people.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Trends show time-bucketed counts by class (week/month); (2) No grades/leaderboards; (3) Empty buckets render honestly (S3-T05). FAIL if UI ranks children or caregivers.

Use_Case: Family creates scoped, time-limited clinician grants and can revoke them.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Grant has scope (clips/classes/dates), expiry, revoke; (2) Download/export flags default off unless family enables; (3) Revoke immediately blocks clinician access. FAIL if revoked grant still returns media/events.

Use_Case: Clinician reviews only grant-scoped episodes in queue/player.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Queue lists only granted items; (2) Player/flags/asks work under RLS; (3) No detect call from clinician app. FAIL if ungranted sessions appear.

Use_Case: Clinician downloads log/PDF for granted scope without depending on a fragile media host.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Export returns structured log and/or PDF for grant scope; (2) Works when VITE_MEDIA_URL is unset for log-only path (S2-T04); (3) Export action is audited. FAIL if export toast-only or requires unreachable media host for log-only.

Use_Case: Family sees who viewed, exported, or downloaded shared material.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) access_log (or equivalent) tallies view/export/download per grant; (2) Family access screen shows those tallies; (3) Clinician cannot clear family-visible audit. FAIL if downloads leave no trace.

Use_Case: One clinician identity reaches multiple family grants; org profile is visible on invite.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Same email/phone clinician sees all active grants sealed per family; (2) Clinician can set org name; (3) Family invite UI shows org (S4-T04). FAIL if families can see each other or org never displays.

Use_Case: Household admin invites members with role and can_record.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Admin invites member with role + can_record (S1-T01); (2) Invitee joins household_members; (3) Non-admin cannot invite. FAIL if invite is toast-only or invitee never joins.

Use_Case: Child-visible recording indicator and pause control that records assent events.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Visible recording indicator while capturing; (2) Pause control discoverable; (3) Pause writes assent_events (S2-T02); (4) No covert capture mode. FAIL if pause has no durable event.

Use_Case: Family acknowledges bystander handling before first share.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) First share blocked until bystander ack recorded; (2) Ack stored with timestamp/actor; (3) Blur/copy present on share path (S2-T01). FAIL if share proceeds without ack.

Use_Case: Capture settings show jurisdiction profile and US default disclosures.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Settings show jurisdiction (US default); (2) Required disclosures shown before first record for that profile (S4-T05); (3) Geography TODO resolved for partner state. FAIL if no jurisdiction field and no disclosure.
Notes: Source=ASSESSMENT; cut-first if slipping; geography TODO

Use_Case: Exposure handling is manual-only with honest trust copy (no fake auto-undress detector).
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Manual blur/remove tools exist; (2) Trust copy states no automated undress/sexualized detector (S5-T04); (3) Undress frames policy matches PRODUCT_SCOPE (on-device discard). FAIL if UI claims auto detection that does not exist.

Use_Case: Flagged sessions keep; unflagged age out per retention_policies.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) retention_policies.where and days saved; (2) Job/path ages out unflagged sessions; (3) Flagged/shared clips exempt until delete (S1-T05). FAIL if prefs never enforced.

Use_Case: Settings state on-device default; cloud is optional and explicit.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Default where=device; (2) Cloud requires explicit choice + backup consent; (3) No fake cost meter (S5-T07). FAIL if cloud is silent default.

Use_Case: Family can export everything and verifiably delete everything.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Export downloads structured metadata + event log (video policy documented) (S1-T03); (2) Delete-everything hard-deletes household-owned rows and clears IndexedDB with UI confirmation (S1-T04); (3) Not toast-only. FAIL if stubs remain.

Use_Case: Review proves grant scoping and no bulk media dump path.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Written blast-radius review (S6-T03) covers RLS, keys, no bulk media API; (2) Gaps filed to backlog; (3) Hosting evidence attached. FAIL if review is missing before pilot sign-off.

Use_Case: Household auth and roles work; member admin via invite.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Supabase auth signs in family users; (2) Roles on household_members; (3) Invite path (S1-T01) strengthens weak member admin. FAIL if unauthenticated access to household data.

Use_Case: Child attached to two guardian households across homes.
Acceptance_Criteria: Deferred - dual/split household not in pilot. S6-T04 memo.

Use_Case: Productized encryption and US residency posture.
Acceptance_Criteria: Deferred - infra/ops track; Hosting_Owner Abhishek/Mainak. S6-T04 memo.

Use_Case: Each purpose consent is separately togglable and stored with a stable purpose tag.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when ALL of: (1) UI exposes four independent toggles - backup (cloud_backup), recordings (train_on_recordings), corrections (train_on_corrections), analytics (product_analytics) - keys in apps/family CONSENT_PURPOSE; (2) None required to use the app; (3) Each toggle upserts app.consents row with purpose tag + granted boolean + created_at (not a single bundled blob); (4) Reload restores per-purpose state from consents table; (5) Share grants remain separate from these four (S4-T02). FAIL if one master switch writes all purposes, or storage lacks purpose tags.

Use_Case: Unsupervised family detect never requires a biometric gallery.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Family path identity off; (2) No gallery enrollment required to score; (3) EdgeFace not on unsupervised detect path / demo labeled (S5-T08). FAIL if detect blocked without face enroll.

Use_Case: COPPA checklist and required disclosures before first record.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Checklist exists under docs/; (2) Required disclosures shown before first record (S4-T01); (3) Partner geography known (TODO Mainak). FAIL if first record with zero disclosure.

Use_Case: Critical share/view/export/delete actions append to an audit log.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Append-only audit_events (or equivalent) for share/view/export/delete (S4-T03); (2) Entries include actor, action, target ids, timestamp; (3) Clients cannot update/delete past rows. FAIL if destructive actions leave no audit row.

Use_Case: Product never scores/ranks people and never offers covert capture.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) No person grades/leaderboards; (2) No covert/hidden capture mode in UI; (3) Constraints documented on trust page. FAIL if covert mode or ranking ships.

Use_Case: New account creates household and first child without SQL seed.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Signed-in user creates household + first child in-app (S1-T02); (2) No manual SQL seed required; (3) Child appears on home with guardianship. FAIL if onboarding dead-ends at empty home.

Use_Case: Paid subscription and billing for consumer product.
Acceptance_Criteria: Deferred - open product decision. S6-T04 memo.

Use_Case: Family sees what we record, never do, and who can see data.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) In-app trust page linked from settings (S2-T03); (2) Copy matches invariants (no scoring, family owns data, post-capture detect); (3) Lists who can see shared grants. FAIL if trust page missing or contradicts product.

Use_Case: Consented funnel events: signup → first capture → first share.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Events fire only if analytics consent (product_analytics) granted; (2) Funnel steps logged without child PII (S5-T02); (3) Off when consent false. FAIL if analytics fire without consent.

Use_Case: Aggregate metrics for households/sessions/events/shares without child identifiers.
Acceptance_Criteria: PASS when: (1) Versioned metric definitions; (2) Exports omit child-identifying rows (S5-T01); (3) Queryable for pilot. FAIL if metrics dump PII.

Use_Case: Always-on home cameras after mobile pilot.
Acceptance_Criteria: Deferred Phase 2 (home cameras F-9.1..F-9.5). No mobile-pilot AC. Capture decision/date/owner in S6-T04 deferral memo after mobile pilot.

Use_Case: Center-based ABA agency platform with live alerting.
Acceptance_Criteria: Deferred until agency detailing pass (E-10..E-15). No pilot AC. Capture decision/date/owner in S6-T04 deferral memo. Do not staff build until B2C pilot data exists.
